scripts.build: npm run build -w @easy-generator/contracts && npm run build -w @easy-generator/api && npm run build -w @easy-generator/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @easy-generator/contracts && npm run build -w @easy-generator/api && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web 'npm run dev -w @easy-generator/contracts' 'npm run dev -w @easy-generator/api' 'npm run dev -w @easy-generator/web'
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @easy-generator/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint:boundaries && npm run format:check
scripts.test: npm run build -w @easy-generator/contracts && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.db:ready: npm run build -w @easy-generator/contracts && npm run build -w @easy-generator/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env apps/api/dist/infrastructure/database/initialize-local.js
scripts.check:foundation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.cache/ms-playwright node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
